concerns.text: FR‑006 requires verification of any generated “technical term” (intent entities) against the repository codebase, but no task in tasks.md addresses this verification step. Existing tasks (T006, T007) only verify surface entities.

SC‑002 mandates measuring that ≥90 % of dataset entries are successfully generated across all three models. No task records or asserts this success‑rate metric; T005 only checks generation time and file creation.
